TraderNPCPositions.name: Viktor
TraderNPCPositions.greeting: Hello There. I have work for those brave enough.
greetings: Hello There. I have work for those brave enough.
Back again? Good. I have more tasks for you.
You look capable. I might have something for you.
Glad you found me. Things are getting rough out there.

TraderNPCPositions.name: The Collector
TraderNPCPositions.greeting: Hello stranger. Got some tasks if you're interested.
greetings: Hello stranger. Got some tasks if you're interested.
Ah, a visitor. I always need things collected.
You have the look of someone who can handle themselves.
Perfect timing. I was just thinking I needed help.

TraderNPCPositions.name: Sister Emma
TraderNPCPositions.greeting: Bless you stranger. Can you help me?
greetings: Bless you stranger. Can you help me?
God sent you at the right time. I need assistance.
Welcome traveller. These are dark times but there is always hope.
Peace be with you. I have tasks if you are willing.

TraderNPCPositions.name: Fisher
TraderNPCPositions.greeting: G'day Mate. I need a few things handled. Are you looking for work?
greetings: G'day Mate. I need a few things handled. Are you looking for work?
Crikey, you look like someone who gets things done!
Good to see another survivor. Got some jobs if you're up for it.
Ah, just the person I needed.

Quests.title: Clinic Supplies
Quests.description: My clinic runs on faith and very little else. I have been treating infected wounds with whatever comes through the door — boiled water, improvised bandages, prayers that seem to work about as often as anything else. The tetracycline ran out four days ago. I am not panicking. I have buried enough people to know that panic does not help, but I am asking urgently.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three people will recover who would not have. That is why I keep asking.
Quests.acceptMessage: Tetracycline and bandages. Whatever you can find. There are three people in the church right now who need the antibiotics specifically.

Quests.title: Long Hunt
Quests.description: I feed anyone who comes to the church. Right now that is eleven people, and the canned food is nearly gone. I am not a hunter — I was a field medic, not a soldier — but I know deer are in the forest east of Kabanino because I can hear them at night. I am asking for help with a directness that suggests I have already asked everyone in the church and been refused.
Quests.rewardMessage: Eleven people ate tonight who were not sure they would. Thank you.
Quests.acceptMessage: Two deer. The forest east of the village. There is a clearing where they graze at dusk. I have watched from the church tower.

Quests.title: Wolves
Quests.description: I do not ask for violence lightly. I have spent two years trying to save lives, not end them. But the wolf pack moving through the woods north of Kabanino has attacked two of her scouts in the last week, and one of them — a young man named Pavel — is going to lose two fingers from the frostbite and the wound combined. I am asking now because I was waiting to see if the wolves would move on. They did not.
Quests.rewardMessage: Pavel will keep his fingers. The forest is quiet. I lit a candle for the wolves too. I know that sounds strange.
Quests.acceptMessage: The pack runs north of the village. Five wolves, possibly six. I need them gone, not scattered. If they scatter they come back.

Quests.title: Eradicate
Quests.description: The wolf situation has worsened. The pack is larger than I thought — I can count at least twelve from the church tower on a clear night. Three more scouts have been turned back. A child wandered out of the church last week and was found an hour later, unharmed, standing very still while three wolves circled her. I am shaking as she describes this. She wants them gone.
Quests.rewardMessage: The forest has been quiet for four days. The children played outside this morning. I had forgotten what that sounded like.
Quests.acceptMessage: All of them. Twenty if there are twenty. The children cannot leave the church while the pack is this close.

Quests.title: Weapons for the Camp
Quests.description: I do not like weapons. I have made peace with the necessity of them. Several survivors at the church have no way to defend themselves and I have been treating the wounded long enough to know that being unarmed in the current world is a death sentence I am not willing to write for my people. I need rifles — functional, reliable, and I am asking with more difficulty than anything else I have asked for.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three people at the church now have weapons and know how to use them. I pray they never need to.
Quests.acceptMessage: Any working rifles you can find. I do not care about the make. I care that they fire and that the people here can learn to use them.

Quests.title: Delivery
Quests.description: I have a package that needs to reach The Collector at Altar Radio Tower.
Quests.rewardMessage: Delivered clean. I will put it to good use.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take this package to The Collector at Altar Radio Tower.

Quests.title: Last Rites
Quests.description: Sister Emma needs a Bible to perform last rites. Take this to her at the church in Kabanino
Quests.rewardMessage: She will rest easier now. Thank you for doing this.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take this Bible to Sister Emma in Kabanino church.

Quests.title: Delivery 3
Quests.description: I Finally got Fisher's new Rod ready. Can you deliver it to Fisher at Black Lake?
Quests.rewardMessage: Delivered safe. I don't forget a favour.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take this Fishing Rod to Fisher at Black Lake.

Quests.title: Lost Hooks
Quests.description: I did not plan to need fishing hooks. She planned for almost everything else — radio equipment, medical supplies, weapon components — but overlooked the simple reality that fish are easier to catch than deer. Her hooks went over the cliff with a piece of equipment I was testing. I need them replaced before she mentions this to Fisher.
Quests.rewardMessage: Do not mention this to anyone. The incident is closed.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four hooks and two metres of netting. Nothing fancy. Do not tell Fisher I asked.

Quests.title: Lean Times
Quests.description: My runners have been living on half rations for a week. The convoys from the south stopped coming and the camp stores are almost gone. He needs non-perishables — anything that keeps.
Quests.rewardMessage: This buys us another week. Maybe two. I won't forget this.
Quests.acceptMessage: Tinned food, rice, whatever you can carry. No questions about where it came from.

Quests.title: The Road North
Quests.description: My primary supply route north has become a deathtrap. Infected cluster at the road bends where bodies from early in the outbreak are still lying. My runners won't move until the path is clear.
Quests.rewardMessage: The route is open. That route is worth more than any gun right now.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty infected between the junction and the forest line. Clear them and my runners can move again.

Quests.title: The Lost Package
Quests.description: One of My most reliable runners dropped a sealed package somewhere near Novodmitrovsk before going dark. I don't know if the runner is dead or just lying low. The package matters more than the runner, which tells you something about Viktor.
Quests.rewardMessage: Still sealed. Good. You didn't open it. I respect that.
Quests.acceptMessage: A portable radio — small, black, military issue. Someone dropped it near Novo. Find it before someone else does.

Quests.title: Medicine Run
Quests.description: I need medical supplies delivered to Sister Emma at Kabanino church. She is treating wounded survivors.
Quests.rewardMessage: Emma will have what she needs. You may have saved lives today.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get this Epinephrine to Sister Emma quickly. Lives depend on it.

Quests.title: Hungry Camp
Quests.description: I don't ask for charity. He calculates value. Right now, boar meat trades at four times the value of canned goods in my network — lighter to carry, higher calorie density. He needs three boars taken near the eastern forest before a rival camp finds them first.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good timing. We will eat tonight instead of trading for the right to eat tomorrow.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three boars, eastern treeline. There is a sounder that moves through at dusk. Efficient.

Quests.title: God's Medicine
Quests.description: The tetracycline is gone again. I do not complain about this — she catalogues it, adjusts, adapts, and asks again. I have been to thirty-seven funerals since the outbreak and she tracks the number because I believe the dead deserve to be counted. I will not attend a thirty-eighth if I can avoid it.
Quests.rewardMessage: The clinic is stocked. Two weeks of buffer. I will begin asking for the next supply before the two weeks are up.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty-four tetracycline. Eight bandages. That is the minimum to keep the clinic operational for two weeks.

Quests.title: The Missing
Quests.description: A young survivor named Marta went into the forest three days ago to gather mushrooms and did not come back. I organised a search. The searchers came back without Marta and two of them are treating wolf bites. I believe Marta is still alive — I am practical enough to know the alternative — but the window is closing and I will not stop asking.
Quests.rewardMessage: They found Marta three kilometres north, sheltering in a drainage culvert. She had been there for two days. I am alive.
Quests.acceptMessage: Clear the wolves from the north path and call out for Marta. I will answer if I can hear you. I am nineteen and I am brave.

Quests.title: Holy Water
Quests.description: I use clean water for three things: drinking, wound cleaning, and what she calls the sacraments — the small rituals of the church that I have maintained because I believe, practically, that ritual gives people something to hold onto. The well near the church has been contaminated since a dead cow fell in it two weeks ago. I need purified water until the well can be cleared.
Quests.rewardMessage: The wounds are cleaner. Three people showing improvement who were not yesterday. Clean water is not a small thing.
Quests.acceptMessage: Purification tablets and clean water containers. Six containers minimum. The baptisms can wait — the wound cleaning cannot.

Quests.title: Light in the Dark
Quests.description: I have kept a light burning in the church tower every night since the outbreak. I believe survivors need to see it — a fixed point in the dark that means safety and food and care. The generator failed two weeks ago. I have been using candles. The candles are almost out. She describes the light in the tower as the single most important thing I do every night.
Quests.rewardMessage: The tower is lit again. Three survivors arrived this week who said they had been following the light for two days.
Quests.acceptMessage: Lighters, flares, any light source you can find. The tower must stay lit. People are navigating by it.

Quests.title: Deer for the Poor
Quests.description: I feed survivors who come to my church. I need meat to keep them going.
Quests.rewardMessage: Four deer. The camp will eat tonight because of this.
Quests.acceptMessage: Hunt 4 deer. The hungry come to us and we must not turn them away.

Quests.title: Bait Run
Quests.description: I have been tracking a pattern in animal movement near the tower that requires live bait traps to confirm. I need worms and maggots — not for fishing, though I will not explain the actual purpose. The data is more valuable than the explanation.
Quests.rewardMessage: The pattern is confirmed. The data is extraordinary. I will need considerably more bait.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ten worms, minimum. Maggots acceptable as substitute. The containers in the east lab will keep them viable.

Quests.title: Bear Trouble
Quests.description: A bear destroyed three weeks of stored equipment at the tower base camp. I catalogued the damage with unsettling precision before asking anyone for help — two radio units, one weather monitor, four storage containers. I want the bear dealt with but is more interested in studying the attack pattern than preventing the next one.
Quests.rewardMessage: Attack pattern documented. The bear acted unusually — I have questions about what drew it here.
Quests.acceptMessage: One bear. Fisher's camp had similar trouble — the same animal, possibly. End it.

Quests.title: Net Repair
Quests.description: My nets are the infrastructure of his entire operation. Without them the boats go out and come back with nothing. Two nets were destroyed in a storm that pushed debris through the lake shallows — torn beyond repair by something large and jagged that Fisher suspects was part of a sunken dock. I need materials to build new ones. He speaks about this the way most people speak about losing a limb.
Quests.rewardMessage: The nets are in the water. The first haul is tonight. If it is good you will have earned more than I paid.
Quests.acceptMessage: Netting material and rope. Enough for two full replacement nets. I will build them myself.

Quests.title: Fuel Delivery
Quests.description: I agreed six weeks ago to supply Viktor with fish in exchange for fuel deliveries to run the camp generator. Viktor has held up his end. I have held up his end. The fuel needs to move on schedule or the arrangement breaks down, and I do not break arrangements — it is the only thing that keeps the whole network from collapsing into theft and violence.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor confirmed receipt on schedule. The arrangement holds. That is the only outcome I wanted.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three canisters to Viktor at Novo. On time. Viktor runs his operation on schedules and I will not be the reason one slips.

Quests.title: Clearing the Shore
Quests.description: Infected have been gathering along the fishing spots near the coast, making it impossible to work the nets safely. I have been monitoring the pattern — she believes they are following a scent trail from a body that washed ashore three weeks ago. I do not particularly care about Fisher's fishing operation. She cares about the data the clustering pattern provides.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three of them showed signs of saltwater exposure. They came from offshore. This is deeply significant.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty infected along the shore. Clear them and let me know if any appear to have come from the water. That part matters to me.

Quests.title: Rare Find
Quests.description: I have heard a rumour — third-hand, which she notes reduces reliability by sixty percent — that a Winchester Model 70 is sitting in a farmhouse south of the radio tower. Pre-outbreak military surplus, possibly. I want it for the archive. The condition does not matter. The fact of its survival does.
Quests.rewardMessage: 1962 manufacture. The rifling is still clean. Forty years of proper storage and two years of apocalypse and it survived. Remarkable.
Quests.acceptMessage: A Winchester 70. Farmhouse south of the tower, ground floor. If it is not there, check the adjacent barn.

Quests.title: Pistol Collection
Quests.description: My sidearm archive is missing three specific variants I have been cataloguing across the region. I am methodical about this in a way that most survivors find unsettling — I have a running list, cross-referenced against pre-outbreak manufacturing data, and she checks items off with the same expression regardless of what they cost to acquire.
Quests.rewardMessage: Two more entries closed. The archive grows. It will matter to someone, eventually.
Quests.acceptMessage: A Glock 19 and a CZ 75. Condition secondary. Presence in the archive primary.

Quests.title: Optics Wanted
Quests.description: I have a theory about optical manufacturing quality before and after the outbreak — specifically which lenses survived storage and which degraded. I need examples from different manufacturers, different grades. I will not pay less simply because the science sounds obscure. The science is not obscure. Most people are just not paying attention.
Quests.rewardMessage: The degradation rate differential is exactly as I predicted. The Soviet optic outperformed the Western design by a factor of three. Interesting.
Quests.acceptMessage: An ACOG and a PSO-1. Different origins, different manufacturing. I need the comparison data.

Quests.title: Suppressor Hunt
Quests.description: I want suppressors for my archive but I am also pragmatic. I trade two of everything — one for the archive, one for currency. Suppressors are rare enough to be worth considerably more than most weapons, and I have three outstanding debts she intends to settle in hardware rather than food.
Quests.rewardMessage: Debts settled. Archive updated. Two entries I had listed as unresolved for four months.
Quests.acceptMessage: An AK suppressor and an M4 suppressor. I will not explain what the archive entry looks like for a suppressor. You can imagine.

Quests.title: Ammo Stockpile
Quests.description: I do not fight often but I am not naive about survival. Her ammunition reserve has been drawn down by three trades she made in the last month — she gave more than she intended to because the information she received was worth it. Now the reserve needs rebuilding before the next trade.
Quests.rewardMessage: Reserve rebuilt. I have room to negotiate again.
Quests.acceptMessage: Common calibres — 7.62x39, 5.56, 9mm. Whatever is easiest to source. I am not proud about calibre at this inventory level.

Quests.title: Word from The Collector
Quests.description: I have been corresponding with Viktor for three weeks through intermediaries. She prefers direct communication but the distance and the risk of message interception have forced her to work through proxies. This letter contains information I have withheld until I was certain. I am now certain.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor responded within the hour. Whatever was in that letter, he did not sleep last night.
Quests.acceptMessage: This goes to Viktor and no one else. Do not read it. You cannot open it anyway — it is sealed with a method Viktor will recognise.

Quests.title: Medicines for Emma
Quests.description: I have sourced a case of tetracycline from a looted pharmacy — more than I will ever need, acquired in a bulk trade she made for other reasons. I have no particular sentiment about Emma's clinic but I am a precise accountant of value, and field-grade antibiotics going unused while people die of infections is, by her calculation, an inefficiency I find irritating.
Quests.rewardMessage: Emma sent gratitude I did not ask for. I will tolerate it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take the tetracycline to Emma. Tell her it came from surplus stock. The word surplus is important.

Quests.title: Tackle for the Fisher
Quests.description: I acquired a crate of fishing hooks in a bulk trade she made for something else entirely. I have catalogued them — forty-seven hooks, three varieties, pre-outbreak manufacture — and determined they have no research value. Fisher, by contrast, would consider this a windfall. I do not waste things.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher's response was characteristically blunt. He said 'about time'. I will accept that as gratitude.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take the hooks to Fisher. Do not describe them as a gift. Call it a trade in anticipation of future consideration.

Quests.title: Message for Viktor
Quests.description: I have been treating a survivor who escaped from a camp sixty kilometres north — badly wounded, feverish, barely coherent. In a lucid moment the survivor gave Emma a location and a name. The location matches where Viktor operates. The name is someone Viktor thought was dead. I do not know what it means but I know Viktor needs to know immediately.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor went quiet for a long time. Then he said thank you. It is the first time I have heard him say that without conditions.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take this to Viktor. Tell him the survivor's name is Olek. He will understand. Do not speak it on the road.

Quests.title: A Gift for The Collector
Quests.description: I found an annotated copy of Kafka's The Metamorphosis in the ruins of a house I was sheltering in. The annotations are remarkable — someone understood this book very deeply. I have read it twice and thought about The Collector, who I have never met but has heard described by Viktor as someone who collects things that have survived. This book has survived. She wants it to go somewhere it will be valued.
Quests.rewardMessage: The Collector sent a response I did not expect — detailed notes on the annotations with her own additions. I have read them four times.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take the book to The Collector at the radio tower. Tell her it was found in a house in Kabanino and that the annotations are worth reading.

Quests.title: Food for the Coast
Quests.description: I have more canned food than I can store and Fisher's coast camp has more people than food. The logic is simple. I am good at simple logistics when the complication is human need rather than bureaucracy. I have packed three crates and needs them delivered before the cans I cannot store begin to spoil.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher sent back dried fish in exchange. More than I expected. More than I asked for. That is very Fisher.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three crates to Fisher. He knows they are coming — I sent word. Tell him the surplus is real this time, not a loan.

Quests.title: Message for Viktor
Quests.description: Fisher has spotted military activity along the coast road. Viktor needs to know. Take this report north.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good intel. I'll put it to use.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get this report to Viktor. The faster the better.

Quests.title: Salvage for The Collector
Quests.description: I pulled up something unusual in my nets — looks valuable. The Collector at the radio tower is the one to know what it is. Take it to her.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fascinating. Tell Fisher I owe him one.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take this salvage to The Collector. She'll know its worth.

Quests.title: Supplies for Emma
Quests.description: Fisher set aside some medical supplies from a wrecked boat. He's no use for them himself. Emma's camp needs them more.
Quests.rewardMessage: God bless him. These will save lives.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take these supplies to Sister Emma in Kabanino.

Quests.title: Eyes on the Tower
Quests.description: I have been watching the Altar Radio Tower for two weeks. Someone is using the equipment up there — he can see lights at night and the interference on his radio band has patterns he doesn't recognise. The Collector would know what it means. I need this information delivered before I acts on it.
Quests.rewardMessage: She confirmed what I suspected. That information changes everything.
Quests.acceptMessage: A written summary of what I have observed. Get it to The Collector without stopping. I need her read on this.

Quests.title: Redirected Aid
Quests.description: A supply drop intended for Emma's clinic was intercepted and stripped by a group of opportunists before it could be delivered. I recovered what was left — bandages, mostly. He wants them delivered to Emma with an explanation he hasn't written yet.
Quests.rewardMessage: You delivered it straight. That matters more than the supplies.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take these to Emma. And tell her what happened. She deserves to know.

Quests.title: The Fisher's Trade
Quests.description: I intercepted a salvage cache that had Fisher's name written on it in marker — someone at the coast left it for him. My holding it as a favour. Fisher's goodwill is worth more than whatever's in the crate. This is I being politically smart.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher received it. He knows what it means. That is enough.
Quests.acceptMessage: A bundle of rope and some hardware. Fisher knows it is coming. Tell him I expect the favour returned.

Quests.title: Field Medic
Quests.description: I run my camp like a military unit — and military units bleed. His people get into firefights, accidents, and the occasional disagreement that turns physical. He needs medical supplies at a rate that concerns even him.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three people survived this week who would not have otherwise. This is what supply runs are for.
Quests.acceptMessage: Morphine, epinephrine, bandages. As much as you can carry. Do not ask who it is for.

Quests.title: Radio Check
Quests.description: My two long-range radios have gone silent. He doesn't know if it's the batteries, the equipment, or something worse. Without comms, he's blind to anything more than five kilometres away — and right now that is a liability he cannot afford.
Quests.rewardMessage: The radios are live again. Now I know what is moving out there.
Quests.acceptMessage: Batteries and a portable radio if you can find one. I need my ears back.

Quests.title: Winter Cache
Quests.description: I think three months ahead. The others react to the present. That gap in planning is why my camp will survive winter and others will not. He is filling caches now — food, fuel, and tools — so that when the roads freeze, his people have options.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three caches stocked. When the snow comes, those supplies will be worth ten times what you see now.
Quests.acceptMessage: Non-perishables and cooking equipment. Tinned food, a pot, whatever keeps. Cache it before the ground freezes.

Quests.title: Generator Fuel
Quests.description: My camp generator runs the lights, the radio repeater, and the small heater that keeps the medical area above freezing. Without fuel it goes dark. In winter, going dark means people die. He has been rationing for two weeks and it shows.
Quests.rewardMessage: The lights are on. The radio repeater is up. We can breathe again.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three canisters of petrol. The generator runs on ethanol mix if you cannot find pure petrol. Do not bring diesel.

Quests.title: Tool Run
Quests.description: My camp maintenance has fallen behind because no one can find a working hacksaw. A former construction site near Novo should have tools. If the infected haven't completely overrun it — and they may have.
Quests.rewardMessage: Everything I needed. The camp maintenance backlog drops by a third.
Quests.acceptMessage: A hacksaw, duct tape, WD-40 or any lubricant. If you find a screwdriver set, take that too.

Quests.title: Clear the Road
Quests.description: The highway junction north of Novodmitrovsk is completely impassable. A convoy got ambushed there in the early weeks and the vehicles are still blocking the road. Infected cluster around the wreckage — drawn by the smell, probably — and My supply trucks cannot push through.
Quests.rewardMessage: Junction is clear. The convoy moved through in under ten minutes. Clean work.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty-five infected at the junction. You have done this before. Get it done before my next convoy moves.

Quests.title: Deer Season
Quests.description: The camp is hungry and I amn't above asking for help putting meat on the table.
Quests.rewardMessage: That'll feed people for a few days at least.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three deer. The camp eats tonight.

Quests.title: Wolf Pack
Quests.description: A pack of eight wolves has been tracking My runners along the northern forest road. Three runners have been forced to turn back in the last week — one badly mauled. I do not tolerate anything that disrupts my supply lines.
Quests.rewardMessage: No wolf sightings since. The northern road is functional again.
Quests.acceptMessage: The whole pack. Do not scatter them — that just moves the problem. Find them and finish it.

Quests.title: Boar Cull
Quests.description: The boar problem has escalated. What started as minor crop damage has become a genuine security issue — three boars broke into the supply tent last night and destroyed enough food to set the camp back a week. I am not calm about this.
Quests.rewardMessage: The tent is repaired. The food loss is manageable. Do not let it happen again.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five boars. I want them all gone. The camp cannot afford another night like last night.

Quests.title: Parts for Fisher
Quests.description: My salvage team pulled a marine diesel fuel pump from a sunken boat near the coast road. Fisher has been asking about one for two months — his primary fishing vessel has been running at half capacity without it. I am doing this as much for the alliance as for Fisher personally.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher's boat is running properly again. That increases his haul, which increases his trading stock. A good return on a fuel pump.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get the pump to Fisher. He will know what it is. Tell him it comes with no strings this time.

Quests.title: Medicine Pledge
Quests.description: Six weeks ago I made Emma a promise — when he found military-grade antibiotics, he would send them to the church. He found them three days ago in a dead soldier's pack. I do not break promises. It is how he stays trusted.
Quests.rewardMessage: Emma sent word back that the antibiotics saved two lives in the first week. A promise worth keeping.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take these to Emma. Tell her the promise is kept. She will know what that means.

Quests.title: Map Drop
Quests.description: I have spent two weeks compiling a map of infected movement patterns near the Altar Radio Tower. The patterns are not random — something is drawing them. The Collector needs to see this before I acts on what it might mean.
Quests.rewardMessage: The Collector confirmed my theory. What is drawing them is not natural.
Quests.acceptMessage: The map is sealed. Get it to The Collector without delay. She will understand its significance.

Quests.title: Morale Package
Quests.description: Fisher's crew have been working eighteen-hour days preparing for winter. I respect that kind of work even if he would not say so. He put together a care package — small luxuries, things the coast cannot easily source. It is as close to generosity as I gets.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher sent back a crate of smoked fish. Unexpected. I respect that.
Quests.acceptMessage: Tell Fisher it is from Viktor. He will appreciate knowing I noticed.

Quests.title: Scripture Run
Quests.description: I found a bible in the ruins of a ransacked church north of Novodmitrovsk. He is not a religious man. He does not understand why Emma would want it. But he understands that things with meaning to people have value, and Emma has been more use to this alliance than most.
Quests.rewardMessage: Emma cried. I did not expect that. Some things survive the world ending.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take it to Emma. Do not drop it. I do not know why it matters but she will.

Quests.title: Data Cache
Quests.description: Viktor stripped a flash drive from a dead CDF soldier. It is encrypted. He cannot read it. The Collector has equipment at the tower that might. I do not know what is on it but the soldier was moving alone and armed with weapons above his rank — which means it matters.
Quests.rewardMessage: The Collector decrypted it. She is not sharing what was on it yet. That worries me.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get this to The Collector. Tell her the soldier was Sergeant rank carrying a Colonel's loadout. She will understand why that is significant.

Quests.title: Night Vision
Quests.description: I have a buyer for night vision equipment — a survivor group three days north who are willing to pay in radio components I need badly. I have not told them the price yet. I am waiting until I have the equipment in hand. She negotiates from a position of supply, never demand.
Quests.rewardMessage: The trade completed at twice the rate I initially calculated. The buyer was desperate. I simply waited.
Quests.acceptMessage: A PNV-10T. Military grade. Civilian equivalents will not satisfy the buyer and will damage my reputation.

Quests.title: Blade Collection
Quests.description: I have recently begun documenting edged weapons — not out of aesthetic interest but because blades require craft in a way that firearms do not, and craft degrades in predictable ways under survival conditions. I want specimens across the range: hunting, combat, improvised. The contrast is the data.
Quests.rewardMessage: The hunting knife shows micro-corrosion consistent with two years of heavy use. The combat knife is nearly pristine. That contrast tells me something about the people who owned them.
Quests.acceptMessage: A hunting knife and a combat knife. If you find a machete, bring that too. Improvised blades especially interesting.

Quests.title: Surplus Ammo
Quests.description: My trading inventory is running low on the common calibres that most survivors will accept as currency. I trade in information and hardware, and both trades require the other party to feel they are receiving value. Common ammunition is the simplest demonstration of good faith.
Quests.rewardMessage: Inventory restocked. Three pending trades can now proceed.
Quests.acceptMessage: 7.62x39 and 5.56. As much as you can carry. I will reimburse the weight in trade goods.

Quests.title: Field Rations
Quests.description: I do not leave the tower often. When I do it is at night, for reasons I do not share. I need provisions for extended operations — calorie-dense, compact, long shelf life. I have been at reduced rations for a week and it is affecting my data collection, whichhe considers a more significant problem than the hunger itself.
Quests.rewardMessage: Rations restored. Concentration metrics returning to baseline. Thank you.
Quests.acceptMessage: Tinned food, rice, anything with shelf life. I require minimum 3,000 calories per day to maintain concentration. I have calculated this precisely.

Quests.title: Map Collection
Quests.description: I have been building a layered map of the region since she arrived at the tower — one layer for infected movement, one for survivor camp locations, one for resource sites, one for anomalies I have not yet classified. I need more base maps to work from. Paper ones. Pre-outbreak official surveys.
Quests.rewardMessage: A military topographic survey from 2019. This fills the gap in the eastern quadrant I have been working around for months.
Quests.acceptMessage: Any map you can find. Military survey maps most useful. Tourist maps acceptable. Hand-drawn community maps invaluable.

Quests.title: Tower Defence
Quests.description: Infected have been clustering around the base of the radio tower making resupply runs dangerous. Clear them out.

objectives.description: Kill 20 Infected near the radio tower

Quests.rewardMessage: Good. I can hear myself think again.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty infected. The approach to the tower must be clear.

Quests.title: Pest Control
Quests.description: Wolves have been circling the tower at night for a week. I have been logging their behaviour — the pattern suggests they are drawn to sound or heat rather than food, which is unusual. I want them cleared, but only after I have completed her observation notes. I will signal when I am ready. Efficiency over urgency.
Quests.rewardMessage: The data collected during the observation window is exceptional. The clearing was necessary. Both outcomes were optimal.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six wolves. Not before I send word that the observation window is closed.

Quests.title: Trophy Hunt
Quests.description: I want a bear pelt. I will not explain why — I have a habit of not explaining things that she considers self-evident. What is clear is that I have asked three times in the last month and the pelt has not materialised, which I find inefficient.
Quests.rewardMessage: Condition: excellent. This will serve the purpose. The purpose remains unspecified.
Quests.acceptMessage: One bear pelt. Undamaged as possible. The condition matters more than the speed.

Quests.title: Trade Goods for Viktor
Quests.description: I have surplus weapons components that Viktor can use — AK parts, maintenance tools, cleaning kits. I am not being charitable. I am making a calculated trade: Viktor's goodwill and access to his route network are worth considerably more than the hardware. I am also, incidentally, clearing storage space I need for the archive.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor's response was unexpected. He sent more back than I anticipated. I may have undervalued my position.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take these to Viktor. He will know their value. Tell him the ledger is now in his favour by this amount.

Quests.title: Rare Book
Quests.description: I acquired a copy of Kafka's The Trial in a trade two months ago. I have read it twice — once for the text, once for annotations someone made in the margins that she found more interesting than Kafka. I have decided Emma would value it more than I do. This is, for The Collector, an unusually generous impulse, and I am slightly unsure what to make of it.
Quests.rewardMessage: Emma sent back a pressed flower from the church garden. I did not expect that. I have added it to the archive.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take the book to Emma. Do not read the margin notes. They are private.

Quests.title: Fishing Gear
Quests.description: I acquired fishing equipment in a bulk trade without realising it was in the crate. I have no use for fishing rods. She catalogued them anyway — force of habit — and determined they are better quality than Fisher's current kit. The optimal outcome is to get them to Fisher. I am annoyed at the inefficiency of having acquired them in the first place.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher examined them and said nothing for a long time. Then he said they were adequate. I consider that high praise from Fisher.
Quests.acceptMessage: Fishing rods and hooks to Fisher. Tell him the quality is superior to what he is using. He will not believe me but you can confirm it.

Quests.title: Viktor's Intel
Quests.description: I have compiled a dossier on survivor camp locations Viktor does not know about — three camps within his network's range that he has been unaware of for months. Two are potential allies. One concerns her. I am sending all three because Viktor's judgement on people is, she acknowledges, considerably better than hers.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor reviewed the dossier overnight. He agrees with my assessment of the northern camp. He is already moving.
Quests.acceptMessage: This dossier goes to Viktor with a verbal note: the northern camp on page four should be approached with caution. The data supports it.

Quests.title: Medical Drop
Quests.description: I salvaged saline bags from the wreckage of a crashed ambulance six kilometres from the tower. She carried them back herself, at night, in three trips. I will not say why I was out at night. The saline bags are for Emma's clinic, which is running critical. I do not volunteer the fact that she made three trips.
Quests.rewardMessage: The patient survived. Emma sent word at dawn. I noted the time.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three saline bags to Emma. Urgently. Her clinic has a patient in serious condition.

Quests.title: Healing Hands
Quests.description: My clinic has been overwhelmed with infected wounds this week — three separate groups arrived in two days, all with the same kind of jagged lacerations consistent with broken glass or torn metal. Someone or something is driving people into dangerous buildings. I cannot treat the wounds without antiseptic. I am asking while simultaneously changing bandages.
Quests.rewardMessage: Seven wounds closed and clean. The infection risk has dropped significantly. Thank you.
Quests.acceptMessage: Disinfectant spray and sewing kits. The wounds need to be cleaned before they can be closed.

Quests.title: Survival Cache
Quests.description: I am putting together emergency survival caches around the settlement. I need the basics - rope, a knife, something to start a fire, and a way to purify water.
Quests.rewardMessage: This will keep people alive out there. Good work.
Quests.acceptMessage: Rope, knives, lighters, purification tablets. The basics. Don't come back without them.

Quests.title: Safe Passage
Quests.description: I have been rigging a warning system around the church perimeter — trip lines, bells made from tin cans, a series of markers visible from the tower. I need rope and wire to complete the outer ring. When it is done, nothing can approach the church at night without her knowing. She describes the system with the quiet pride of someone who has not slept well in two years.
Quests.rewardMessage: The perimeter is complete. I slept four hours last night without waking. The first time in eight months.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five ropes and two reels of barbed wire. The system is already half built. I just need to close the gaps.

Quests.title: Cooking for Many
Quests.description: I feed everyone who arrives at the church — always, regardless of who they are or what they have done. I do not ask questions at the door. I have been doing this for two years and I have fed people she later learned were dangerous and people I was certain would not survive the week. Both groups have surprised her, in opposite directions.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fourteen people ate hot food tonight. That sounds small. It is not small.
Quests.acceptMessage: Cooking pots, a knife, fuel if you can find it. The gas burner in the church kitchen died last week.

Quests.title: Pain Relief
Quests.description: I have three patients who are in genuine pain — not discomfort, not the general difficulty of survival, but acute pain from injuries that needed better treatment than she could provide. I have been managing with what I have. I am asking for morphine and epinephrine now because asking earlier felt, I admit, like a luxury I was not entitled to. I was wrong about that.
Quests.rewardMessage: The pain is managed. The patients are resting. This is what medicine is for.
Quests.acceptMessage: Morphine for the pain. Epinephrine in case of shock during treatment. I will not use more than I need.

Quests.title: Protect the Flock
Quests.description: Infected have begun gathering outside the church in larger numbers than I have seen since the first months. I do not know what has changed — the weather, the season, a source of sound or smell I cannot identify. What I know is that two people have been unable to leave the church for three days and I cannot provide care to people who cannot reach her.
Quests.rewardMessage: The roads are passable. Four new arrivals came through within an hour of the clearing. They had been waiting.
Quests.acceptMessage: Clear the infected from the church perimeter and the road south. People need to be able to reach us.

Quests.title: The Pack Returns
Quests.description: The wolf pack Emma dealt with before has returned — or a different pack has found the same territory. A survivor arrived at the church last night with wounds consistent with a wolf attack. He had been running for six hours. I cleaned the wounds and listened to where he had come from. The location is the same forest. I am less patient about this than the first time.
Quests.rewardMessage: The survivor who was attacked is recovering. He said he would help clear the north forest next time himself. I believe him.
Quests.acceptMessage: The north forest. Fifteen wolves minimum from the survivor's account. I am asking you to end this. Completely.

Quests.title: Mercy Kill
Quests.description: A bear has been circling the village for four days — visibly injured, one leg dragging, moving with the erratic pattern of an animal in severe pain. I watch it from the church tower every morning. I have decided that allowing it to suffer is not consistent with her beliefs, and that its presence near the village is a danger I cannot justify. She frames this as a mercy, not a kill. The distinction matters to her.

objectives.description: Put the bear out of its misery

Quests.rewardMessage: I watched from the tower. It was quick. Thank you for that.
Quests.acceptMessage: The bear circles the east side of the village at dawn. It will not run. It cannot. Make it quick.

Quests.title: Word to Fisher
Quests.description: I heard through a survivor that Fisher's camp lost three people in a bear attack at the shore last week. I do not know Fisher well — we have met twice — but I have sent medical supplies south twice and he has never sent thanks. I do not require thanks. I require that his people are alive to receive my supplies. I am sending word and medical support.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher responded eventually. He said no one died from the wounds. That is his version of gratitude and I accept it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take these supplies to Fisher. Tell him I sent them. And tell him if he loses anyone to infection from those wounds, it is because he did not get help fast enough.

Quests.title: Candle for Viktor
Quests.description: I pray for Viktor every night. I am aware he would find this uncomfortable. I have decided to send him a physical token — a candle she made herself from rendered fat and a wick cut from her own spare clothing — as a reminder that someone is keeping track of whether he survives. I know Viktor operates on debts and favours. I am sending this with no expectation of return. She wants him to know what that feels like.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor sent back a case of antibiotics and no explanation. I think he understood.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take the candle to Viktor. Do not explain it. Let him work out what it means.

Quests.title: Offering for The Collector
Quests.description: I have been thinking about The Collector since the book exchange. I know The Collector is alone at the tower — truly alone, in a way that Emma, surrounded by survivors, is not. I have prayed about what to send and has decided on another book, this one with her own annotations. I am aware this may be presumptuous. I send it anyway.
Quests.rewardMessage: The Collector responded with a twelve-page letter analysing the annotations. I have been reading it for three days. We are, I think, becoming friends.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take the book to The Collector. Tell her the annotations are a conversation, not a lecture.

Quests.title: Saline for the Shore
Quests.description: Fisher's crew works the water in all weather and injuries are frequent — lacerations, fractures, the occasional drowning that becomes a near-drowning if they are lucky. I have been sending basic supplies south for months. I am upgrading what I send: saline bags, enough to manage serious blood loss for at least a week. She hopes Fisher has someone who knows how to use them.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fisher's camp now has two people who know basic IV procedure. I taught them by radio. It took four sessions.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six saline bags, carefully packed. Tell Fisher to keep them cold if possible and to train at least two people in IV administration.

Quests.title: Church Records
Quests.description: I have been keeping records since the first week — names, dates, circumstances, last known locations of family members. I have documented four hundred and twelve survivors who have passed through the church. I am sending a copy of the records to Viktor because she trusts him to protect them if something happens to her, and because I need a reason to believe someone else knows these people existed.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor sent back confirmation that he has the records secured. He did not comment on their content. I did not expect him to.
Quests.acceptMessage: A copy of the records. Viktor will understand their value. Tell him they are not for trading.

Quests.title: Net and Line
Quests.description: My replacement nets are in the water but the lines holding them are already showing wear — he used substandard rope from a cache that had been sitting in damp conditions too long. He knew when he tied them that they were wrong but he had nothing better. I need proper replacement line before the nets drift and he loses them to the current.
Quests.rewardMessage: The lines are replaced. I lost one net to the current before you came back. The other four are holding.
Quests.acceptMessage: Fishing line — actual fishing line, not rope. And netting twine if you can find any. I need to restring half the net system.

Quests.title: Boat Repair
Quests.description: My main rowboat — the one I have used for twenty years, before the outbreak and through it — took a rock through the hull in shallow water near the eastern shore. The rock took a section of planking the size of a dinner plate. Fisher patched it with canvas and is keeping the boat out of water until I can do it properly. He describes the damage in a tone that suggests he takes it personally.
Quests.rewardMessage: My boat is repaired. I'll take her out at dawn to test the hull. Thank you so much, my friend.
Quests.acceptMessage: Wooden planks and nails. Sealant if you find any — tar, resin, anything waterproof. The hull needs to be tight before that boat goes back in the water.

Quests.title: Camp Supplies
Quests.description: My camp crew works hard and eats more than Fisher planned for. I have been feeding twelve people on provisions for eight — the extras arrived three weeks ago, refugees from a flooded settlement inland. I did not turn them away. I do not explain this decision. He simply states the supply deficit and what is needed to close it.
Quests.rewardMessage: The camp is provisioned for two weeks. The new people are working the nets now. They were fishermen before. Useful.
Quests.acceptMessage: Food and clean water. However much you can carry. The deficit is twelve people times three weeks. That is a lot of cans.

Quests.title: Shore Salvage
Quests.description: I have been watching wreckage accumulate on the eastern shore for a week — debris from something large that came apart offshore. I do not know what it was. I know that debris means components, and components mean repairs, trade goods, or both. The items are still in the wreck — get there before the tide takes them.
Quests.rewardMessage: The wreckage was a supply barge. The cargo hold was half intact. What you brought back sets us up for a month.
Quests.acceptMessage: The shipwreck on the eastern shore. A fuel canister and two batteries. They are in the hold — get there before the tide.

Quests.title: Storm Prep
Quests.description: I watch the water the way a doctor watches a patient — he reads it, interprets it, draws conclusions three days ahead. The current and the cloud pattern both say storm. A significant one. I need the camp secured before it hits — equipment stored, boats pulled, fuel cached above the flood line. I am calm about this in the way of someone who has weathered storms before.
Quests.rewardMessage: The storm hit last night. The camp held. The boats are intact. Planning ahead is not caution — it is mathematics.
Quests.acceptMessage: Rope to secure the boats, tarps to cover the equipment, containers to cache the fuel. Two days. Maybe less.

Quests.title: Shore Clearance
Quests.description: Infected have been washing ashore from somewhere offshore — possibly the sunken vessels I have been tracking on my rough charts, possibly something else. My crew cannot work the beach nets safely with infected emerging from the water at unpredictable intervals. Two crew members have refused to work the shore nets at all. I don't blame them. I do need it solved.
Quests.rewardMessage: The crew is back on the beach nets. The haul tonight was the best in a month. Sometimes the solution is simple.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty infected on the shore approach. Check the waterline too — some of them seem to come up from below.

Quests.title: Wolf at the Water
Quests.description: Wolves have found the fish drying racks at the shore and have begun raiding them at night. I set up a watch but the wolves are patient — they wait until the watch changes and hit the racks in the gap. I respect the tactic in a detached professional way while also wanting them gone.
Quests.rewardMessage: The racks have not been touched in three days. The watch rotation no longer has a gap.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four wolves working the shore at dusk. They move as a unit. Do not let them scatter.

Quests.title: Big Game
Quests.description: A boar has been raiding My food stores for two weeks. Not a normal boar — this one is large enough that three crew members tried to drive it off with noise and it stood its ground. I measured the tracks. Fifty kilos minimum, possibly seventy. I have decided that trapping it is not practical and that shooting it requires someone with better aim than anyone at the camp.

objectives.description: Kill the large Boar raiding the camp

Quests.rewardMessage: You found it. It was larger than I calculated. The camp has meat for a week.
Quests.acceptMessage: One boar. Large. It raids from the north side of the store tent. It is not afraid of people.

Quests.title: Viktor's Order
Quests.description: Viktor placed an order six weeks ago and I have had it ready for four. The delay is Viktor's — his runners could not make the run safely. I am not annoyed. I charge storage. It is in the terms. What I need now is someone to move it north before Viktor decides he no longer needs what he ordered, which would be a waste of four weeks of preparation.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor confirmed receipt. I said nothing about the storage charge. I consider that acceptance.
Quests.acceptMessage: The package is sealed and marked for Viktor. It goes to him directly — not to my camp, not to a runner. Viktor himself.

Quests.title: Emma's Medicine
Quests.description: I pulled a medical kit from a sunken boat last week — intact, waterproof case, contents dry. I have no use for it. I thought about trading it but the calculation came out in Emma's favour: I eat what Emma cannot use, and Emma heals people I cannot afford to lose. I am sending the kit with no arrangement and no debt created. He finds this arrangement efficient.
Quests.rewardMessage: Emma asked where it came from. I said the lake. She looked at me in a way that suggested she did not entirely believe that. Good enough.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take the kit to Emma. Tell her it is from the lake, not from Fisher. SI will ask. Just say the lake.

Quests.title: Collector's Find
Quests.description: My net pulled up something last week that I cannot identify — a sealed metal case with markings I do not recognise, watertight, heavy, clearly pre-outbreak manufacture. I have not opened it. He considered it and decided that if I cannot identify it he should not be the one to open it. The Collector can identify anything. I am sending it to her with the net coordinates where it was found.
Quests.rewardMessage: The Collector identified the case within an hour. SI have not said what it contained. SI have asked for the net coordinates for three adjacent grid squares.
Quests.acceptMessage: The case goes to The Collector. The coordinates are written on the label. SI will want them.

Quests.title: Rope for Viktor
Quests.description: Viktor asked Fisher for rope three weeks ago. Fisher ordered it then realised the quantity Viktor requested is more than any one runner can carry. I have been packaging it in sections. It is ready now. I need someone to carry it north in two trips or one trip with a large enough pack. I do not ask why Viktor needs rope in those quantities. I have learned not to ask Viktor that kind of question.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viktor sent a crate of ammunition in return. No note. No explanation. That is how Viktor says thank you.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six rope bundles to Viktor. Two trips if you have to. I know it is coming.

Quests.title: Parts for The Collector
Quests.description: I have been salvaging electronic components from waterlogged equipment for two months — not because I need them but because The Collector mentioned once, in passing, that she needed radio frequency components and he remembered. I have assembled what he thinks is most of what she described. I am not certain because I do not entirely understand what sI need them for. I send them anyway.
Quests.rewardMessage: The Collector identified exactly what she needed in My collection. She sent back three detailed questions about where the components were salvaged from. I wrote down the locations.
Quests.acceptMessage: A collection of electronic components to The Collector. Tell her I have been saving them since February. SI will know what that means.

Quests.title: Population Count
Quests.description: I track survivor populations the way a chess player tracks pieces. Right now he believes there are three significant survivor groups within twenty kilometres that he has not made contact with. He needs someone to scout without engaging — headcount only, no recruitment.
Quests.rewardMessage: Forty-three. Higher than I expected. That changes my supply projections significantly.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three locations marked on your map. Count heads and come back. Do not speak to them. I need unbiased numbers.

Quests.title: Collector's Bounty
Quests.description: I am offering a standing bounty on military-grade weapons — not for my archive but for a trade I am building toward that requires hardware I do not have. I will not say who the trade is with. I will not say what she expects to receive. I will pay the bounty as stated.
Quests.rewardMessage: Seven entries closed in one delivery. The trade I am building toward is now viable.
Quests.acceptMessage: Military weapons, any condition. She maintains a running list. Check at collection.

Quests.title: The Long Vigil
Quests.description: I have been sitting with a dying survivor for three days — a man I found collapsed on the church steps with no identification, no equipment, and wounds that suggested he had been running for a long time. He has been unconscious since he arrived. I have not left his side except to treat other patients. I need supplies to continue the vigil without the clinic failing around her.
Quests.rewardMessage: The man regained consciousness this morning. He asked where he was. I told him he was safe. He wept. So did I.
Quests.acceptMessage: Medical supplies for the clinic and food for Emma herself. I have not eaten properly in two days.

Quests.title: The Final Haul
Quests.description: I am planning the largest single fishing operation of the post-outbreak period — every boat, every net, every crew member, working a three-day continuous haul before winter closes the deep lake access. I have been planning this for six weeks. The infected on the approach and the wolf pack near the north shore are the only things standing between the camp and the biggest food reserve it has ever had.

objectives.description: Kill 3 Wolves on the shore road

Quests.rewardMessage: The haul ran three days and two nights. The camp now has enough fish to last the winter. That was the plan. The plan worked.
Quests.acceptMessage: Thirty infected on the east approach, three wolves on the north shore. Clear both before the boats go out at dawn.

Quests.title: The Grand Collection
Quests.description: I have been working toward this for six months. She calls it the Grand Collection — a complete inventory of every significant weapon type that has survived in the region, documented, catalogued, cross-referenced. I need four specific pieces that have eluded her. When she describes it you realise I have been building toward this since the first week she arrived at the tower alone with three crates of salvage. This is what I have been doing all along.
Quests.rewardMessage: The collection is complete. I have been working toward this for six months. I thought I would feel more. I feel precise.
Quests.acceptMessage: An SVD, an M4A1, an AKM, and a Winchester 70. The four pillars of any serious collection. Do not damage them. I will know.

Quests.title: Fox Fur
Quests.description: I need fox pelts. A contact up north is trading warm gear for materials and fox fur is worth more than most people realise.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three foxes. Don't damage the pelts.
Quests.rewardMessage: Clean work. These will trade well.

Quests.title: Bear Pelt
Quests.description: I have a buyer for bear pelts. Bears are hard to find and harder to kill, but the reward reflects that.
Quests.acceptMessage: One bear. Come back in one piece.
Quests.rewardMessage: Didn't think you'd manage it. Good work.

Quests.title: Rabbit Run
Quests.description: Food is getting tight around Novodmitrovsk. I need rabbit meat to keep my people fed through the week.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five rabbits. Every bit helps.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. This will keep people going a few more days.

Quests.title: Reindeer Cull
Quests.description: The reindeer have been destroying food caches near the forest camp. I need the herd thinned before they cause more damage.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four reindeer. They've eaten enough of our supplies.
Quests.rewardMessage: That should discourage the rest of the herd.

Quests.title: Wolf Bounty
Quests.description: A pack of wolves has been tracking survivors moving through the northeastern corridor. I am putting a bounty on them.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five wolves. They've cost us three good runners already.
Quests.rewardMessage: That corridor is safer now. For a while at least.

Quests.title: Armour Recovery
Quests.description: I know where a CDF patrol was ambushed early in the outbreak. The gear is still there. He needs someone to go recover it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Two plate carriers and a ballistic helmet. The site is hot with infected.
Quests.rewardMessage: This is exactly what I needed. Good intel work.

Quests.title: Night Operations
Quests.description: I need night vision for a job he won't explain in detail. He just says it's important and he'll pay well.
Quests.acceptMessage: A PNV-10T. Don't ask what it's for.
Quests.rewardMessage: Exactly what I needed. The less you know the better.

Quests.title: Suppressor Stock
Quests.description: My quiet work requires quiet tools. He needs suppressors — military grade if possible.
Quests.acceptMessage: Two suppressors. I don't care what calibre.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will serve well. Quiet is how you stay alive.

Quests.title: Uniform Run
Quests.description: I need CDF uniforms for a plan he's putting together. He won't say why, but he's paid on time before.
Quests.acceptMessage: Two jackets, two pairs of trousers. Military pattern.
Quests.rewardMessage: Perfect. These will be put to good use.

Quests.title: Radio Silence
Quests.description: I intercepted a transmission suggesting another group is watching the northeastern forest route. He needs comms equipment to counter-surveil.
Quests.acceptMessage: A portable radio and a battery. I'll handle the rest.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. Now I know what they know.

Quests.title: Field Craft
Quests.description: I am teaching a group of new survivors basic field craft. He needs materials to demonstrate with.
Quests.acceptMessage: Rope, wooden planks, nails. The basics of staying alive.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will do. Good to have someone who knows how to find things.

Quests.title: Shelter Materials
Quests.description: The camp needs new shelter before winter sets in. I am gathering materials and needs everyone to contribute.
Quests.acceptMessage: Planks, nails, tarp if you can find it. We're building before the snow comes.
Quests.rewardMessage: The camp will be warmer for this. You've earned your place here.

Quests.title: Improvised Armoury
Quests.description: I want stone knives and bone tools cached at waypoints along my route. They're not pretty but they keep people alive.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five stone knives. Make them yourself or find them — doesn't matter.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will do the job. Every cache point covered.

Quests.title: Dead Drop
Quests.description: I intercepted a message. Someone is leaving dead drops along the northern route — information that could change the balance of power in this region. The contact leaves a copy of The Raven at the Fire Station in Chernaya Polyana. If the book is there, the message is real.
Quests.acceptMessage: The Fire Station in Chernaya Polyana. Ground floor. Find the copy of The Raven and bring it back to me.
Quests.rewardMessage: This is bigger than I thought. I need to talk to Emma and The Collector.

objectives.description: Retrieve the copy of The Raven from the Fire Station in Chernaya Polyana

Quests.title: The Signal — Viktor's Message
Quests.description: I have decoded part of the intercepted signal. He needs you to carry a message to Sister Emma and The Collector. Something is happening — a group with military hardware is moving through the region and they're not friendly.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get this to Emma first, then The Collector. Don't let anyone else see it.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. Now we wait and see what they make of it.

objectives.description: Retrieve The Art of War and deliver it to Sister Emma

Quests.title: Armed Response
Quests.description: The threat is real. My contact confirmed a hostile group is moving through the northeastern corridor — they are driving infected ahead of them to clear the roads. I need the infected cleared from the north road before they can use them as cover to approach the camp.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ten infected on the north road. They are being pushed ahead of the hostile group. Clear them before the group reaches us.
Quests.rewardMessage: That buys us time. Emma and The Collector are already moving.

objectives.description: Clear 10 Infected from the north road

Quests.title: The Signal — Final Preparations
Quests.description: I am pulling in every favour he has. He needs supplies to fortify the northern camp before the hostile group arrives. This is the last run before everything changes.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ammo, medical supplies, rope. Whatever you can carry. We're dug in after this.
Quests.rewardMessage: We're as ready as we're going to be. Whatever comes next — we face it together.

Quests.title: Fuel Cache
Quests.description: My runners need fuel for the vehicles he has hidden. It's hard to find and harder to carry.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three canisters of fuel. Don't spill it.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. The vehicles are mobile again.

Quests.title: Blade Cache
Quests.description: Viktor caches backup weapons at every waypoint. He needs knives — reliable, simple, always useful.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four knives. Any kind. Cache points need restocking.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. Every waypoint covered.

Quests.title: Clear the Camp
Quests.description: Infected have moved into an old camp I uses as a waypoint. It needs clearing before my runners can use it again.
Quests.acceptMessage: Fifteen infected cleared from the camp. Don't take any unnecessary risks.
Quests.rewardMessage: Camp's usable again. Good work.

Quests.title: Medical Reserve
Quests.description: I keep a small medical reserve for my runners. It's running low and he won't send anyone out unprepared.
Quests.acceptMessage: Morphine, epinephrine, bandages. The basics.
Quests.rewardMessage: This will keep my people operational. Appreciated.

Quests.title: Goat Problem
Quests.description: Feral goats have been getting into My supply cache near the forest. He needs them dealt with.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four goats. They've eaten through two months of stored food.
Quests.rewardMessage: Finally. That cache should be safe now.

Quests.title: The Informant
Quests.description: I have a contact who needs supplies in exchange for information. He needs someone he trusts to make the drop.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take this to Fisher. He knows what it's about.
Quests.rewardMessage: The information came through. Worth every bullet.

Quests.title: Optics Library
Quests.description: I am cataloguing every optical attachment that's passed through the region. I need more samples.
Quests.acceptMessage: Any scope or optic you find. Condition doesn't matter — I can restore them.
Quests.rewardMessage: Excellent additions. The catalogue grows.

Quests.title: Pistol Archive
Quests.description: I am building a complete archive of sidearms found in the region. Each one goes into my records.
Quests.acceptMessage: A Glock, a CZ75, and a Makarov. Pre-outbreak manufacture if possible.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three more entries in the archive. The collection is almost complete.

Quests.title: Shotgun Specimens
Quests.description: I want every shotgun variant documented. She'll take them off your hands if you find them.
Quests.acceptMessage: Any shotgun. MP-133, MP-43, Blaze — bring what you find.
Quests.rewardMessage: These fill gaps in the archive I've been missing for months.

Quests.title: Medical Archive
Quests.description: I am documenting what medical supplies have remained viable since the outbreak. I need samples from different manufacturers.
Quests.acceptMessage: Morphine, epinephrine, saline. Three of each.
Quests.rewardMessage: Viable after all this time. Remarkable. The data is valuable.

Quests.title: Bear Trophy
Quests.description: I want a bear pelt for my records. She claims it is for scientific documentation. Whether that is true is another matter.
Quests.acceptMessage: One bear pelt. Undamaged if possible.
Quests.rewardMessage: Magnificent specimen. This goes in the archive.

Quests.title: Wolf Study
Quests.description: I am tracking pack behaviour changes since the outbreak. I need data from fresh kills. Specifically, I want wolf kills from the forest near the radio tower.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four wolves. Make note of where you find them.
Quests.rewardMessage: Interesting. The pack has shifted east since last month.

Quests.title: Fox Specimens
Quests.description: I need fox specimens for a study she won't fully explain. The data matters more than the explanation.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three foxes. I want them quickly.
Quests.rewardMessage: Perfect. The study can continue.

Quests.title: Reindeer Data
Quests.description: I want reindeer kills near the radio tower. I am mapping territory shifts in the herd and needs fresh data points.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three reindeer. Mark the locations if you can.
Quests.rewardMessage: The migration pattern is becoming clear. This confirms my hypothesis.

Quests.title: Material Study
Quests.description: I am studying how different materials have degraded since the outbreak. I need samples of bark, stone, and rope.
Quests.acceptMessage: Birch bark, oak bark, stones, rope. This is for research.
Quests.rewardMessage: The degradation rates are fascinating. Thank you.

Quests.title: Pelt Collection
Quests.description: I am building a pre and post outbreak comparison of animal populations through pelt samples. I need a variety.
Quests.acceptMessage: Wolf pelt, fox pelt, deer pelt. One of each.
Quests.rewardMessage: An excellent set. The comparison data will be invaluable.

Quests.title: The Signal — Research
Quests.description: The Collector received Viktor's warning. I have been tracking radio signals from the tower and believes she can identify the hostile group's communication frequency. I need equipment to do it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Batteries and any radio equipment you find. I need to triangulate their position.
Quests.rewardMessage: I have them. They are broadcasting from the southwest. Viktor needs to know.

Quests.title: The Signal — Clear the Tower
Quests.description: I need the radio tower perimeter cleared. The infected are interfering with my equipment and I won't stop the signal analysis for anything.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty infected around the tower perimeter. I cannot work with that noise.
Quests.rewardMessage: Much better. The signal is clear now. I have what I need.

objectives.description: Clear 20 Infected from the tower perimeter

Quests.title: The Signal — Disrupt the Route
Quests.description: I have identified the hostile group's supply route. They are driving infected ahead of them as they move — using the horde as cover. I need someone to clear the infected from the route before they can use them as a shield. Disrupt their advance without engaging the group directly.
Quests.acceptMessage: Fifteen infected on the supply route approach. Clear them and the hostile group loses their cover. Do not engage anyone who looks like a survivor.
Quests.rewardMessage: That will slow them significantly. Fisher needs to know what I have found.

objectives.description: Clear 15 infected from the hostile group's route

Quests.title: The Signal — Collector's Message
Quests.description: I have compiled everything she knows about the hostile group. I need it delivered to Fisher who controls the coastal supply routes they need.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get this to Fisher. He needs to know before they reach the coast.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. The net closes. We may survive this yet.

objectives.description: Deliver The Collector's dossier to Fisher

Quests.title: Sniper Study
Quests.description: I want to document every long-range rifle that's made it to this region. She pays well for unusual finds.
Quests.acceptMessage: A Mosin or SVD. I want to examine the condition after months of field use.
Quests.rewardMessage: Remarkable how well maintained this is. Into the archive.

Quests.title: Attachment Survey
Quests.description: I want to know what weapon attachments are still circulating in the region. I need handguards and stocks.
Quests.acceptMessage: AK handguards and stocks. Whatever variants you can find.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three new variants documented. The survey is nearly complete.

Quests.title: Food Documentation
Quests.description: I am logging what tinned foods are still viable. I need samples from different producers.
Quests.acceptMessage: Tins of tuna, beans, spaghetti. Unopened if possible.
Quests.rewardMessage: Still within parameters. The data is consistent with my models.

Quests.title: Radio Interference
Quests.description: Infected are clustering near the tower again, interfering with the Collector's equipment. They need clearing regularly.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ten infected cleared from around the base of the tower.
Quests.rewardMessage: Acceptable. The readings are stable again.

Quests.title: Equipment Salvage
Quests.description: I need electrical components to maintain my monitoring equipment at the tower.
Quests.acceptMessage: Batteries — as many as you can carry. They drain fast up here.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. The equipment stays operational for another month.

Quests.title: Blood Supply
Quests.description: My aid station is critically low on blood supplies. I need empty blood bags to work with survivors who come in injured.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six empty blood bags. People are dying without them.
Quests.rewardMessage: God willing this will be enough for a while.

Quests.title: Splint Supply
Quests.description: I have been seeing a lot of broken bones lately — people falling, fights, bad landings. I need splints stocked up.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six splints. Simple but lifesaving.
Quests.rewardMessage: Every one of these will make a difference to someone.

Quests.title: Saline Run
Quests.description: The aid station needs IV saline. I have a survivor in serious condition who won't last the week without it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three saline bags. Please hurry.
Quests.rewardMessage: Thank you. He is stable now. God guided your steps today.

Quests.title: Epinephrine Cache
Quests.description: I have seen three anaphylactic reactions this month. I need epinephrine stocked before the next one.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four epinephrine injectors. People react to things out here that never bothered them before.
Quests.rewardMessage: Stocked and ready. The next case won't catch us unprepared.

Quests.title: Mouths to Feed
Quests.description: My aid station feeds survivors who can't fend for themselves. I need meat — any meat — to keep people going.
Quests.acceptMessage: Sheep or goat. The flock near the village is wild now but still there.
Quests.rewardMessage: This will feed many people. You are doing God's work whether you know it or not.

Quests.title: The Rabbit Runs
Quests.description: I need small game to supplement the camp's diet. The children especially need protein.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six rabbits. They are quick but there are plenty out there.
Quests.rewardMessage: The children will eat well tonight. Thank you.

Quests.title: Wolf Threat
Quests.description: A wolf pack has been circling closer to Kabanino. I am worried about the children and the elderly survivors in my care.
Quests.acceptMessage: Drive them off. Six wolves should scatter the rest of the pack.
Quests.rewardMessage: The pack has moved on. We can breathe again.

Quests.title: Light for the Altar
Quests.description: I keep candles burning in the church for survivors who need a moment of peace. She's running low.
Quests.acceptMessage: Any candles or lighters you can find. Small comfort matters more than most people admit.
Quests.rewardMessage: The light will keep burning. That matters more than you might think.

Quests.title: The Written Word
Quests.description: I keep a small library in the church for survivors. Books help people hold onto their humanity. I need more.
Quests.acceptMessage: Any books you find. Knowledge and stories both matter.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will be read and re-read by people who need them.

Quests.title: Aid Station Repairs
Quests.description: My aid station needs maintenance. The roof leaks and the walls need patching before winter.
Quests.acceptMessage: Wooden planks and nails. Nothing complicated — just what's needed.
Quests.rewardMessage: The station will hold through winter now. One less thing to worry about.

Quests.title: Rope for Stretchers
Quests.description: I need rope to make improvised stretchers for moving injured survivors. She loses people in transit because I have nothing to carry them on.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five ropes. People die in the move if we cannot carry them properly.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will save lives that would have been lost in transit. Thank you.

Quests.title: The Signal — Emma's Warning
Quests.description: Emma received Viktor's message. I have been treating survivors who escaped from the south — some of them described armed strangers moving through the villages, taking supplies. I need medicine stockpiled before they arrive.
Quests.acceptMessage: Whatever medical supplies you can find. If they come here I want to be ready.
Quests.rewardMessage: The station is as ready as it can be. God help us.

Quests.title: The Signal — Defend the Church
Quests.description: I have word a hostile group's advance is moving through Kabanino. They always drive infected ahead — using the horde as a distraction. I cannot leave my patients. I need someone to hold the perimeter and clear the infected before they overwhelm the church.
Quests.acceptMessage: Clear the infected from around the church. Twenty-five of them, pushed ahead by whoever is moving through. Do not engage anyone who looks like a survivor.
Quests.rewardMessage: They have passed us by. For now. The Collector's intelligence was right.

objectives.description: Hold the church perimeter — clear 25 infected

Quests.title: The Signal — Emma's Report
Quests.description: I have information about the hostile group that the others need. She treated one of their people who got separated and left for dead. I need this delivered to Viktor and Fisher.
Quests.acceptMessage: Tell Viktor what I have told you. And then tell Fisher. They need to know.
Quests.rewardMessage: Go now. Every hour matters.

Quests.title: Charcoal for Water
Quests.description: I am using charcoal tablets to purify water for the camp. She goes through them faster than I can find them.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ten charcoal tablet packs. Clean water saves more lives than anything else.
