Quests.rewardMessage: This will keep the water safe for weeks. Thank you.

Quests.title: Vitamin Stores
Quests.description: Nutritional deficiencies are becoming a serious problem at the aid station. I need vitamin supplements.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six vitamin bottles. Scurvy is not a medieval problem — it is very much a current one.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will prevent a great deal of suffering. Simple things matter.

Quests.title: Chicken for the Camp
Quests.description: I want to start a small flock at the camp but needs to thin out the feral chickens that have been fouling the water supply first.
Quests.acceptMessage: Eight chickens. They are a menace to the water source.
Quests.rewardMessage: The water is cleaner already. And we have food for a week.

Quests.title: Boar Threat
Quests.description: Boars have been raiding the camp's food stores at night. I need them driven off before there is nothing left.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four boars. They are bold and getting bolder.
Quests.rewardMessage: The stores are safe for now. You have helped more than you know.

Quests.title: Wound Care
Quests.description: I am dealing with infected wounds from survivors who have been hiding in dirty conditions. I need disinfectant.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six bottles or sprays. Any kind. Clean wounds heal.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three people avoided sepsis today because of this. Bless you.

Quests.title: Bear Attack
Quests.description: A bear has killed two survivors in the forest north of Kabanino and is ranging closer to the camp. I need it stopped.
Quests.acceptMessage: One bear. It has already taken two lives. I pray it takes no more.
Quests.rewardMessage: The forest is safer tonight. I will pray for those it took.

Quests.title: Reindeer for the Camp
Quests.description: I need large game to feed the growing number of survivors sheltering at the church. Reindeer would feed many people for days.
Quests.acceptMessage: Two reindeer. Every mouth at the camp needs feeding.
Quests.rewardMessage: The camp will eat well for days. Thank you for this.

Quests.title: Trap Line
Quests.description: I need fish traps set and maintained along the lake shore. Bring him the materials and he'll do the rest.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three fish trap nets. I'll place them where they catch best.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. The trap line is set. Come back in a few days.

Quests.title: Bait Supply
Quests.description: I need bait to keep the lines running. Worms and maggots work best but he'll take what I can get.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ten worms or maggots. Don't make a face — they catch fish.
Quests.rewardMessage: Lines are baited. The lake will provide.

Quests.title: Fishing Kit
Quests.description: I am equipping new survivors to fish for themselves. I need fishing rods and hooks.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three fishing rods and a box of hooks. Teaching a man to fish and all that.
Quests.rewardMessage: Three more people who won't starve. That's three more who might make it.

Quests.title: Boar Cull
Quests.description: Boars are raiding the camp's food stores down by the lake. I need them dealt with before they destroy the winter supply.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five boars. They have gotten bold and I am tired of it.
Quests.rewardMessage: Those were causing real damage. Good riddance.

Quests.title: Sheep Harvest
Quests.description: Feral sheep near the lake are a reliable food source. I need them harvested before another group finds them.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four sheep. First come first served out here.
Quests.rewardMessage: Winter food secured. You work clean, I'll give you that.

Quests.title: Bear at the Shore
Quests.description: A bear has been raiding the fish drying racks at night. I have had enough of sharing his catch with wildlife.
Quests.acceptMessage: One bear. It cost me three days of fish last week.
Quests.rewardMessage: About time. The racks are mine again.

objectives.description: Kill the bear raiding the fish racks

Quests.title: Wolf Warning
Quests.description: Wolves have been spotted along the eastern shore. My runners use that route and he won't have them picked off.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four wolves. The eastern path needs to be safe for my people.
Quests.rewardMessage: The route is clear. My runners can move again.

objectives.description: Clear 4 Wolves from the eastern shore

Quests.title: Deer for the Lake Camp
Quests.description: The lake camp is short on meat. I need deer — the forest south of the lake has a good population if you know where to look.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three deer. Bring them in and I will see you paid fairly.
Quests.rewardMessage: Camp eats tonight. Fair's fair.

objectives.description: Kill 3 Deer for the lake camp

Quests.title: Reindeer Run
Quests.description: Fisher spotted a reindeer herd moving south along the lake shore. I want them taken before they move on.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three reindeer. Don't wait — herds don't stay.
Quests.rewardMessage: That is a winter's worth of meat. You did good.

objectives.description: Kill 3 Reindeer before they move on

Quests.title: Fox Pelts
Quests.description: Fisher trades fox pelts north for supplies I can't get any other way. I need a consistent supply.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four foxes. Clean kills please — damaged pelts don't trade well.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will fetch a fair price. You've earned your cut.

Quests.title: Rabbit Snare
Quests.description: I want to set up a rabbit snare line along the lake but needs someone to hunt them out first to establish territory.
Quests.acceptMessage: Eight rabbits. Show them the territory belongs to us.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. The snare line is going in tomorrow.

Quests.title: Boat Rope
Quests.description: I need rope to rig the boats properly. Without good rope the boats drift and people get into trouble on the lake.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six ropes. Proper rigging saves lives on the water.
Quests.rewardMessage: The boats are rigged right now. No more drifting.

Quests.title: Tool Salvage
Quests.description: Fisher keeps a full toolkit for repairs. I need axes and saws to maintain the dock structures.
Quests.acceptMessage: Two axes and a handsaw. The dock doesn't fix itself.
Quests.rewardMessage: These will last. Good steel is worth more than most people realise.

Quests.title: Fuel for the Boats
Quests.description: My boats run on petrol. I have routes I can't cover without it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four fuel canisters. The lake is bigger than it looks and the boats go through it fast.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. The routes stay open.

Quests.title: Shore Defence
Quests.description: I need the infected cleared from the eastern shore. My supply boats can't land when the shore is overrun.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty infected cleared from the eastern shore landing point. My boats need that beach.
Quests.rewardMessage: Landing point is clear. Boats come in tonight.

objectives.description: Clear 20 Infected from the south shore

Quests.title: The Signal — Coastal Intel
Quests.description: Fisher received The Collector's intelligence. He recognised the group immediately — they came through the coast six weeks ago and took three of my boats. I have left a pair of binoculars at the lighthouse at Rify. Get there, watch the eastern shore approach for signs of movement, and report back what you see.
Quests.acceptMessage: Binoculars are stashed at the Rify lighthouse. Get up there and watch the eastern shore. Take your time — I need a proper read on what's moving.
Quests.rewardMessage: Same route. They are predictable. That is their mistake.

objectives.description: Use binoculars at the Rify Lighthouse to recon the south shore (60 seconds)

Quests.title: The Signal — Cut the Route
Quests.description: I want the hostile group's supply line disrupted at the coast. Clear the infected they are driving ahead of them and slow their advance.
Quests.acceptMessage: Thirty infected on the eastern approach. Every one of them slows the hostile group down.
Quests.rewardMessage: That buys Viktor the time I need. Good work.

objectives.description: Cut the supply route — clear 30 infected

Quests.title: The Signal — Fisher's Stand
Quests.description: The hostile group's advance has been slowed. Viktor, Emma, and The Collector are holding their positions. I need the lake supply route kept open for the final resupply push — his contribution to the alliance.
Quests.acceptMessage: Keep the lake route clear. Emma needs these supplies and sI need them now.
Quests.rewardMessage: Done. The alliance holds. We all made it through this one.

objectives.description: Deliver emergency supplies to Emma via the lake route

Quests.title: Medical for the Shore
Quests.description: My camp has been dealing with injuries from the water and from the work. I need basic medical supplies.
Quests.acceptMessage: Bandages, painkillers, tetracycline. The basics.
Quests.rewardMessage: This will do. My people work hard — they need proper care.

Quests.title: Shore Infection
Quests.description: The eastern shore has a heavy infected presence that is getting worse. I need it thinned before it reaches the lodge.
Quests.acceptMessage: Fifteen infected on the eastern shore. They move inland at night.
Quests.rewardMessage: The shore is passable again. For now.

objectives.description: Clear 15 Infected from the south shore

Quests.title: Dock Planks
Quests.description: The dock needs new planking before the season turns. I built this dock by hand and I intends to keep it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ten wooden planks and some nails. The dock doesn't maintain itself.
Quests.rewardMessage: Dock will hold another season. Good.

Quests.title: Canned Provisions
Quests.description: Fisher trades fish for canned goods with inland survivors. I need tI canned supplies brought in to complete the exchange.
Quests.acceptMessage: Tuna, beans, rice. Canned goods keep and trade well.
Quests.rewardMessage: Fair exchange completed. This is how it should work.

Quests.title: Knife for the Work
Quests.description: My crews use knives constantly — gutting fish, cutting rope, basic camp work. I need to keep the supply up.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four knives. Any kind that holds an edge.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good steel. These will last.

Quests.title: Goat Roundup
Quests.description: Feral goats have moved into the camp perimeter near the lake. I do not share space with goats.
Quests.acceptMessage: Five goats. This is not a negotiation.
Quests.rewardMessage: Perimeter is clear. I do not tolerate intruders — animal or otherwise.

objectives.description: Clear 5 Goats from the camp perimeter

Quests.title: Chicken Removal
Quests.description: Chickens have infested the supply shed near the dock. I have had enough of finding feathers in everything.
Quests.acceptMessage: Six chickens out of the supply shed. I do not care how.
Quests.rewardMessage: Finally. The shed is usable again.

objectives.description: Clear 6 Chickens from the supply shed

Quests.title: Viktor's Delivery
Quests.description: Fisher received word from Viktor. I have a package that needs moving north quietly. Fisher trusts you to do it.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get it to Viktor. No questions.
Quests.rewardMessage: Done right. That is all I ask of anyone.

Quests.title: Emma's Order
Quests.description: Emma sent word to Fisher that sI need medical supplies I have been holding. I want them delivered personally.
Quests.acceptMessage: Take these to Emma. She asked for them by name.
Quests.rewardMessage: Delivered right. Emma will be satisfied.

objectives.description: Deliver medical supplies to Sister Emma

Quests.title: Collector's Specimen
Quests.description: The Collector has an unusual request for Fisher — she wants a specific type of fish bait for a study. I am forwarding the job.
Quests.acceptMessage: Bone hooks and bone bait. The Collector wants them. Don't ask me why.
Quests.rewardMessage: She'll be happy with those. Strange woman but she pays.

Quests.title: Cattle Harvest
Quests.description: There is a small herd of feral cattle near the lake. I want them harvested before another group claims them.
Quests.acceptMessage: Three cattle. Take what you need and bring me what I asked for.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good haul. Winter is covered.

Quests.title: Purify the Water
Quests.description: The lake camp's water supply has been compromised. I need purification tablets before people start getting sick.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ten purification tablet packs. The water is not safe right now.
Quests.rewardMessage: Water is treated. Crisis averted. Good timing.

Quests.title: Screwdriver and Hammer
Quests.description: I need basic tools for boat maintenance and dock repairs. He goes through them constantly.
Quests.acceptMessage: Two screwdrivers and a hammer. Simple tools keep things running.
Quests.rewardMessage: Good. Now I can fix the engine mount.

Quests.title: Shore Run
Quests.description: I need supplies moved along the coast to a waypoint. I do not send his own people on this run — the east road is too hot right now.
Quests.acceptMessage: Get these ropes and planks to the waypoint at the eastern shore. You will know the place.
Quests.rewardMessage: Waypoint is stocked. My people can move again.

Quests.title: Pig Iron
Quests.description: Domestic pigs have gone feral along the eastern shore and they have become aggressive. I have had two of my people injured.
Quests.acceptMessage: Four pigs. Feral pigs are dangerous and I will not lose more people to them.
Quests.rewardMessage: That is the last of them. Shore is safe for my crew again.

Quests.title: After the Signal — Viktor's Assessment
Quests.description: The hostile group moved on. I am not celebrating — he knows they will be back. He wants a full resupply done before the next threat arrives.
Quests.acceptMessage: Ammo, medical supplies, fuel. We rebuild now while we have time.
Quests.rewardMessage: We are stronger for having worked together. Remember that.

Quests.title: After the Signal — The Collector's Records
Quests.description: I have been documenting everything. I believe the hostile group will return in greater numbers and I want the record complete before they do. They left infected behind as they withdrew — a deliberate tactic to slow pursuit. I need the area around the tower cleared so I can continue my work.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty-five infected left behind by the retreating group. Clear them from the tower perimeter and the surrounding area.
Quests.rewardMessage: The record is complete. When they come back, we will be ready.

objectives.description: Clear 25 infected left behind by the retreating group

Quests.title: After the Signal — Emma's Vigil
Quests.description: I have been tending to survivors affected by the hostile group's passage. I need help keeping the aid station running through the aftermath.
Quests.acceptMessage: Whatever you can carry. The need does not stop when the immediate threat does.
Quests.rewardMessage: Every soul that walks through those doors deserves a chance. Thank you for helping give them that.

Quests.title: After the Signal — Fisher's Routes
Quests.description: With the immediate threat gone, I am reopening his supply routes. I need the coast cleared fully so my boats can run again.
Quests.acceptMessage: Twenty five infected on the full eastern shore route. Clear them and the coast is open again.
Quests.rewardMessage: The routes are open. Trade flows. That is how you survive — not through fighting alone but through keeping things moving.

objectives.description: Clear the full south shore route — 25 infected

Quests.title: Eyes on the Airfield
Quests.description: A supply helicopter has been trying to reach us for three days. The pilot won't land at NWAF without eyes on the airfield first — too many bad runs in the early weeks. I need someone to get to the top of the ATC tower and do a proper sweep of the field. If it's clear enough for a landing, the helicopter comes in and people here get supplies they desperately need.
Quests.acceptMessage: I have left binoculars at the base of the ATC tower for you. Get to the top, scan the airfield carefully, and hold the position for a full minute. The pilot needs confidence, not a quick glance.
Quests.rewardMessage: I can't believe they're gone. Thank you for trying. I'll send word to their families.

objectives.description: Use binoculars at the NWAF ATC Tower to scan the airfield (60 seconds)

Quests.title: A Page for the Living
Quests.description: Sister Emma wants a simple record of the people who made it through the airfield run. Bring her clean paper so she can write the names down before the details fade.
Quests.rewardMessage: The page is filled. Thank you. Some victories should be written down.
Quests.acceptMessage: Bring me clean paper. Not for a report. For names.
Quests.journalStory: Emma wrote each name slowly, as if rushing would make them less real. The paper was ordinary, creased at the edge and stained by rain, but by the time she finished it felt heavier than ammunition. This is what survived: names, routes, mistakes, and the small mercy of someone deciding to remember.

Quests.title: Nova Quest
Quests.description: Teste de morte
Quests.rewardMessage: Teste de morte
Quests.acceptMessage: Teste aceito, mate-o!
